name: Global Carbon Budget 2024 surface ocean fCO2 products (CMEMS, fCO2-Residual, SOM-FFN, OceanSODAv2)
model_or_instrument: ML-based mapping products (ensemble of feed-forward neural networks, XGBoost, SOM-FFN)
resolution: regridded to 1°x1°, monthly (native 0.25° to 1°, 8-daily to monthly)

scales.note: Four observation-based fCO2 products with native resolutions ranging from 0.25 to 1 degree and 8-day to monthly intervals, analyzed at 1x1 degree monthly for 1990-2023.
